summary: Gold's slide deepened as the dollar pushed above 104 and real 10-year yields climbed near 2.8%, stripping away its safe-haven bid. Stocks clawed back some of the prior rout with a sharp one-day bounce, even as volatility stayed elevated. Crypto remained the weak spot, extending its drawdown with bitcoin deeply oversold.
tweet: Dollar and real-yield strength hammered gold while stocks bounced off oversold levels and crypto kept sinking.
